files.author: Bilig
modifications: authored by the pipeline script, no third-party geometry or textures: a full adult skeleton (1.75 m, built in metres, scaled x2 to 3.5 scene units, centred on the hips), standing in the anatomical position (palms forward), arms slightly abducted; the figure faces +z, so _L (subject's left) is +x

node names are the content contract: Skel_* (skull with mandible and teeth, cervical and thoracolumbar spine with discs, clavicles, scapulae, 12 rib pairs with costal cartilage, sternum, long bones, hands, pelvis with sacrum, coccyx, patellae, feet), Joint_Ball_Shoulder/Hip_* and Joint_Hinge_Elbow/Knee_* (articular cartilage, subtly highlighted), Muscle_Biceps_R and Muscle_Triceps_R (semi-translucent over the right upper arm); every node is one mesh (one primitive per material)

skull: one implicit (signed-distance) solid for cranium and face with real orbits, nasal aperture and zygomatic arches, meshed by surface nets and simplified with meshoptimizer; mandible likewise; bones elsewhere are seeded-noise tubes, (super)ellipsoids and thick sheets

look: ivory bone (per-vertex colour with seeded noise tone, baked cavity shading, darkened orbits and faint cranial sutures; tileable procedural bump normal map; faint clearcoat), pale blue-white glossy cartilage with a slight emissive lift on the joint nodes, red translucent muscle with fibre streaks and white tendons
deterministic (mulberry32 / seeded gradient noise): a rebuild gives the same bytes
gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation; KHR_materials_clearcoat, KHR_texture_transform
